tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: Di che cosa è stufo Marco?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “A che cosa è interessata Sara?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. The blue tile is an adjective. A choice tile such as “di / a” means: pick the preposition that goes with this adjective (stufo di, interessato a, preoccupato per, abituato a). Then fit the article in: di + il = del, a + il = al, di + l' = dell'. Make the adjective agree with the person (interessato / interessata). A tile in brackets such as (io) says who is meant; you don't write it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Stufo di: sono stufo del rumore.
